title: Spanish A1 Latin American Grammar Exercise Bank
design_notes: Rebalanced from the original 400-item bank after A1 coverage cross-checking.
Latin American Spanish focus: uses ustedes, not vosotros.

Adds time/date, numbers, tú/usted, accent pairs, stem-changing verbs, high-frequency irregulars, near future, obligation, modals, progressive, weather, quantity, comparisons, nationality, possession and frequency.
Context is represented inside exercises and review rather than as a separate Workshop activity.
The exercises are original app content, structured for reuse rather than copied from external exercise banks.
